mappings.note: Title/Superscription matches exactly in content (To the choirmaster; of the sons of Korah; A Psalm).
Content matches: 'Lord, you have been favorable to your land...'
Content matches: 'You have forgiven the iniquity of your people...' (Includes Selah).
Content matches: 'You have withdrawn all your wrath...'
Content matches: 'Restore us again, O God of our salvation...'
Content matches: 'Will you be angry with us forever?...'
Content matches: 'Will you not revive us again...?'
Content matches: 'Let us see your steadfastness, O Lord...'
Content matches: 'I will listen to what God the Lord says...' (Includes the clause about not returning to folly).
Content matches: 'Surely his salvation is near those who fear him...'
Content matches: 'Steadfast love and faithfulness meet; righteousness and peace kiss each other.'
Content matches: 'Faithfulness springs up from the ground...'
Content matches: 'The Lord will also give what is good...'

This verse exists in the translation but has no corresponding text in the OSMAIN (which ends at v13). This is likely an addition from a different textual tradition or a misnumbering where this content belongs to Psalm 85:14 in other versions, but it is absent here.

extraContent.description: The translation includes verse 14 ('La justice marchera devant lui...') which is completely missing from the OSMAIN text provided. The OSMAIN text ends at verse 13.
